theater: 蒙古高原瀚海與弱水之間

battle.name: 魏攻柔然之戰
battle.theater: 蒙古高原瀚海與弱水之間
battle.brief: 公元429年（太延元年），北魏太武帝拓跋燾自雲中出塞，分道深入瀚海與弱水一線，大破柔然可汗大檀所部，斬首三萬餘級，逼其西遁。卡面的羅馬短劍是羅馬共和末期軍團的近身兵器，與本役相隔五百餘年，不在戰陣之中；當時陣前所用，是柔然的角弓、骨鍍矛、彎刀與北魏的鐵槊、環首刀。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭是北魏太武帝拓跋燾對漠北游牧聯盟柔然的一次大規模北伐，發生在太延元年（公元429年），戰場在今蒙古高原中部的瀚海與弱水之間。北魏一方以平城為都的拓跋部鮮卑王朝為主體，太武帝自領中軍出塞，諸軍分道並進，兵種以騎兵為骨幹，輔以重裝步兵與隨軍工匠，軍資由牛車與馬匹馱運，編制仍沿用拓跋部以來以「軍」為單位的部伍制，設校尉、將、帥分統。柔然一方是四〇二年由社崗在鹿渾建立的游牧帝國，汗庭直轄的部落其實只是聯盟的核心，控弦之眾號稱百萬，實際作戰多為各部落自備的輕騎，裝備自製程度低，攻城能力近乎空白。柔然真正的弱點不在戰力而在結構：它靠劫掠漠南農地與牧場維生，與北燕、後秦和親，也與南朝宋、齊、梁通好，一旦北魏在正面壓上，它便要在聯盟內部重新分配兵馬。第三方並非置身事外：高車（敕勒）諸部早已被柔然征服並被迫隨征，河西的北涼沮渠氏與青海的吐谷渾各自自保，柔然留下的空白正是由它們與後來崛起的突厥填補。
countriesEn: This war was a large northern expedition by Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei, Tuoba Tao, against the nomadic confederation of the Rouran, fought in the first year of Taiyan (429 CE) on the central Mongolian plateau, between the Hanjai desert and the Rouran River. On the Wei side the war was fought by the Tuoba Xianbei dynasty with its capital at Pingcheng, a state that had been Sinicising itself step by step since it founded the Dai kingdom; Taiwu led the central column in person, the other armies advanced by separate routes, cavalry forming the backbone of the force, with armoured foot and travelling craftsmen in support, and the baggage carried by ox-carts and by pack animals, the army still organised on the old tribal basis of the jun as the unit, with xiaowei, generals and commanders commanding in turn. The Rouran side was the nomadic empire founded in 402 by Shegang at Luhun, a league whose court-centred tribes were only the core of the whole: it claimed a hundred thousand bow-armed riders, but in practice the fighting men were light cavalry raised and equipped by each tribe, with low levels of local manufacture and almost no capacity for siege. The real weakness of the Rouran lay not in their fighting power but in their structure: they lived by raiding the farmland and pastures of the southern steppe, they had married into the Northern Yan and Later Qin, and they kept relations with the southern courts of Song, Qi and Liang, so that once Wei pressed from the front they had to redistribute their forces inside the league. The third parties were not idle bystanders: the Gaoche, or Jiele, tribes had long been conquered by the Rouran and were driven into the campaign with them; in Hexi the Northern Liang house of Juqu and in Qinghai the Tuyuhun each looked to their own interests, and the vacuum left by the collapse of the Rouran was filled by them and later by the Turks.
people: 主導者是北魏太武帝拓跋燾。他生於公元四〇八年，十六歲即位，於始光元年以來數度北征柔然，太延元年自將大軍出塞時年僅二十一歲，全程御營在軍隊之中，選鋒、追擊與回師的時機都由他定奪。出謀劃策者是相國崔浩，這位清河崔氏出身的漢人士大夫是太武帝最倚重的謀臣，他主張趁國力鼎盛先摧柔然、再取河西，並在行軍途中以軍旅為題建議立碑記功，由他撰成的崑崙山碑文成為本役最主要的文字紀錄；碑文雖於其後被毀，存世片段仍可見其自陳武功赫奕、威震遠方。柔然方面的關鍵人物是可汗大檀，他自四一四年起據有汗位，《宋書》作檀檀，控弦雖多，內部諸部不協，本役遭重創後同年死去，汗位由敕連可汗接替，後者退保漠北西路，十五年後仍被太武帝追殺，柔然此後一蹶不振。與大檀同時被捲入戰局的，還有隨軍的柔然貴族與各部首領，以及被強迫充當前鋒的高車騎隊；魏軍方面，則是各道將領與沿途被徵發的部眾，一起承擔了這場長距離進軍的消耗。
peopleEn: The man who directed the war was Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei, Tuoba Tao. Born in 408 CE, he had acceded to the throne at sixteen and had campaigned against the Rouran more than once since the first year of Shiguang; when he led the great army out of the passes in the first year of Taiyan he was only twenty-one years old, and the imperial camp stayed with the troops throughout, so that the choice of the assault, the pursuit and the timing of the withdrawal were all his decisions. The strategist was the chancellor Cui Hao, a scholar-official of the Qinghe Cui clan who was the Han adviser on whom Taiwu relied most; he argued that the moment of strength should be used to break the Rouran first and take Hexi afterwards, and on the march he proposed that a stele be raised to record the campaign, and the text of the Kunlun Mountain stele that he composed became the principal written record of the war. The stele was later destroyed, but the surviving fragments still speak in a tone of self-congratulation, of martial merit made manifest and of terror carried far abroad. The key figure on the Rouran side was the khagan Datān, who had held the throne since 414 and whom the Song history calls Tantan; he commanded many bow-armed riders but could not hold his tribes together, and after being badly hit in this campaign he died within the year, the khanship passing to the chanyu Chilian, who withdrew to the western roads of the northern steppe and was hunted down by Taiwu fifteen years later, after which the Rouran never recovered. Also caught in the war with Datān were the Rouran nobles and tribal leaders who marched with him and the Gaoche cavalry pressed into the van; on the Wei side it was the commanders of the several columns and the levies taken up along the route who together bore the drain of a march of this length.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬短劍，是共和末期至帝政早期羅馬軍團步兵的制式近身兵器：刃長約五十至六十厘米，葉形雙刃而中起一道血槽，柄短、配重頭寬，單手握持，配合大橢圓盾使用，出征時的標準組合是長矛或標槍、刀與盾三件套。它在本役中的位置是象徵性的，而非實戰性的：公元四二九年，羅馬共和式的軍團編制在歐洲大陸上早已解體，西部帝國的政權名存實亡，短劍被更長的直刃長劍取代，在東羅馬的晚期軍隊裏也退居次要，普遍裝備的是長劍與雙刃短刀；至於中國與蒙古高原，這種兵器更是從未出現。真正在瀚海與弱水之間列陣的，是柔然騎兵的角弓與骨石箭鏃、骨鍍矛與木矛、單刃反曲的彎刀、皮甲與皮盔，以及汗庭的成群帳幕與牧群；北魏軍則以鐵槊、環首刀、戟與盾為骨幹，配札甲與鎖子甲、強弓與弩，並攜帶雲梯、撞車等攻具與大批輜重車隊。兩軍在武器上的差距不在工藝而在體量與後勤：柔然能帶走的只有馬與牛羊，北魏必須帶走糧食與攻具，這正是遠征在補給線上最脆弱的一環。
kitsEn: The Roman short sword on the card was the standard close-combat arm of Roman legionary infantry from the late Republic into the early Empire: a blade of roughly fifty to sixty centimetres, leaf-shaped and double-edged with a central rib, a short grip and a broad pommel, held one-handed and used behind the large oval shield, the marching combination of the legion being pilum or long spear, short sword and shield. Its place in this campaign is symbolic rather than practical. By 429 CE the Republican legionary system had long since dissolved in Europe, the authority of the western empire had become a formality, the short sword had been displaced by the longer straight spatha, and in the late armies of the eastern Roman state it had become secondary as well, the spatha and the double-edged knife being the general issue; in China and on the Mongolian plateau the weapon had simply never existed. What really stood in the ranks between the Hanjai and the Rouran River was the Rouran cavalry with its composite horns bows and bone, stone and iron arrowheads, bone-tipped spears and wooden lances, single-edged recurved sabres, leather armour and leather helmets, together with the court's countless tents and herds; the Wei army had the iron lance, the ring-pommel sabre, the halberd and the shield as its backbone, with lamellar and mail armour, strong bows and crossbows, and it carried scaling ladders, battering rams and a great train of baggage carts. The gap between the two sides in weapons lay not in workmanship but in bulk and logistics: the Rouran could take only horses and cattle with them, the Wei had to bring grain and siege equipment, and that was the weakest joint in a distant expedition.
tactics: 北魏的打法是典型的草原長驅。柔然不築城、不守塞，沒有可以攻取的固定目標，魏軍因此不與之糾纏，而是以多路分進的騎兵大隊直插其腹地：主力自雲中、陰山一線出塞，分為數道，搜索柔然游騎的所在，然後一部咬住其鋒、一部繞出其側後，專打帳幕、馬群與分散的部落，迫其往北荒方向潰竄，最後以追擊的騎兵把潰散與疲憊轉成戰果。史書記太武帝自以輕騎先行別率大軍，途中遇柔然游兵輒破之，說明先鋒與主力之間有一段可以拉開的距離。柔然方面的應對則是利用草原縱深與遊牧式的疏散：汗庭下令各部收拾帳幕、驅趕馬群向西或向北移動，企圖用距離拖垮魏軍；其軍法仍沿用社崗立國時的舊制，以千人為軍、置將一人，以百人為幢、置帥一人，先登者有賞而退卻者以石擊首，這套賞罰嚴厲的編制在順境時能保持銳氣，在撤退與潰散時卻容易斷裂。魏軍的補給靠沿途徵取與俘獲的牛羊維持，瀚海一線缺水少草，戰馬的損失一旦超過替換能力，攻勢就會自行停滯。
tacticsEn: The Wei method was the classic long pursuit across grass. The Rouran built no cities and held no passes; there was no fixed objective to assault, and the Wei therefore refused to be drawn into a set-piece engagement. Instead they drove deep into the heart of the steppe with several separate columns of cavalry: the main body left the line of Yungang and the Yin mountains by several roads, searched out the whereabouts of the Rouran outriders, and then one part bit into their front while another swung round their flank to strike the tents, the horse herds and the separated clans, driving them off towards the wastes of the north, after which pursuing cavalry turned disorder and exhaustion into casualties. The histories record that Taiwu went ahead in person with a light force as a separate column and broke the Rouran skirmishers he met on the way, which shows that a distance was kept between the vanguard and the main body. The Rouran answer was to use the depth of the grass and nomadic dispersal: the court ordered each clan to break camp and drive its herds west or north, hoping to tire the Wei out through distance. Their military code still followed the arrangements made by Shegang when the state was founded, a thousand men to the jun with one general over it and a hundred men to the zhuang with one commander over it, reward for those who first scaled a wall and the man who gave ground killed by a stone to the head; that stern code could keep an army keen when things went well, but it broke easily once retreat and dispersal began. The Wei kept themselves supplied by taking cattle and sheep along the route and capturing them, and since the Hanjai belt was short of water and fodder, once the loss of horses outran the rate of replacement the offensive stopped of its own accord.
data: 可以寫進這場戰役的數字大致如下。時間是北魏太延元年（公元四二九年）七月出塞，八、九月在漠北接戰，秋冬之間回師。兵員方面，傳世史籍對北魏出戰兵員有二十餘萬與三十萬兩種記載，學者多認為這類數目包含沿途徵發與輸送的總量，實際投入作戰的騎兵應明顯少於此；柔然方面，傳稱控弦百萬，也有史書記作二十餘萬，同樣是概括各部落的概數，汗庭直轄的核心兵力遠少於此。戰果方面，史書記此役斬首三萬餘級、俘虜二萬餘口、掠馬牛羊以百萬計。行程方面，自雲中出塞至弱水一線，直線距離已近九百公里，若把傳統上解作貝加爾湖的北海算作盡頭，單程更超過一千四百公里，迂迴與追擊使實際路程更長。往後的時間軸是：四二九年大檀死、敕連可汗即位，四四四年前後太武帝再親征柔然，敕連可汗被追殺，柔然此後走向崩潰，直到五五五年被突厥所滅。
dataEn: The figures that can be given for this campaign are roughly these. The time was the first year of Taiyan of Northern Wei, 429 CE: the army left in the seventh month, met the Rouran in the northern steppe in the eighth and ninth months, and returned during the autumn and winter. As for strength, the transmitted histories give two figures for the Wei army, something over two hundred thousand and three hundred thousand, and most scholars take such numbers to include levies raised along the route and the whole of the transport, the cavalry actually committed to battle being noticeably fewer. On the Rouran side the claim of a hundred thousand bow-armed riders, with some histories giving something over twenty thousand, is likewise a round figure covering the several clans, the core troops under the court's own hand being far fewer. As for results, the histories record that the campaign cut down more than thirty thousand, took more than twenty thousand prisoners and carried off horses, cattle and sheep by the hundred thousand. As for distance, the direct line from Yungong to the Rouran River is close to nine hundred kilometres, and if the traditional reading of the North Sea as Lake Baikal is taken as the end of the march the single way exceeds fourteen hundred, the real road being longer still because of turning and pursuit. The later timetable runs as follows: Datān died in 429 and Chilian succeeded him; around 444 Taiwu campaigned against the Rouran again and Chilian was hunted down; the Rouran went from there towards collapse, and were finally destroyed by the Turks in 555.
cause: 打起來的直接理由，是柔然年年入塞。柔然的畜牧經濟必須靠定期南下搶奪農地與草場來補足，每到秋高馬壯便成群越過陰山，抄掠五原、雲中一帶的屯田與邊鎮，毀壞禾稼、驅走牲畜，北魏的邊防與糧道因此年年被扯動。太武帝無法長期容忍這種消耗，尤其在他先後平定赫連夏、內部整合完成、國力推到頂峰之後，北伐的條件成熟。戰略上的理由同樣清楚：柔然是北魏背後唯一能與南朝南北夾擊的力量，柔然與北燕互有婚好，又與宋、齊、梁通好，一旦北魏在中原用兵而柔然同時南下，平城與南朝之間的戰略平衡就會被打破。因此摧毀柔然並非只為報復邊患，而是要消滅這個可以牽制北魏的第三方。內在的機會則來自柔然自身的鬆散：可汗大檀與諸部首領各懷勢力，聯盟只是共戴一個汗號，並無一致的戰時指揮，一旦受挫便各自散去。漢人謀臣崔浩則把這一役寫進了北魏的武功簿：北伐既成，碑功當立，以此為北魏在正統王朝之外另立功業的憑據。
causeEn: The immediate reason for fighting was that the Rouran came over the border every year. A pastoral economy had to be topped up by regular raiding of farmland and pasture, and every autumn, when the horses were fat, the clans came south in masses over the Yin mountains to plunder the colonies and frontier garrisons of Wuyuan and Yungong, destroying crops and driving off cattle, so that the frontier defence and the grain road of Northern Wei were pulled and strained year after year. Taiwu could not tolerate that drain for long, least of all after he had destroyed the Xia of Helian and completed the internal consolidation that brought the state's strength to its peak, for at that point the conditions for a northern expedition were ripe. The strategic reason was equally plain: the Rouran were the only power behind the Wei capable of pincering the empire together with the southern courts. They intermarried with the Northern Yan and kept relations with Song, Qi and Liang, so that if the Wei fought in the central plains while the Rouran moved south at the same time, the strategic balance between Pingcheng and the south would break. To destroy the Rouran was therefore not a matter of punishing border raids but of removing the third party that could hold the Wei in check. The opening came from the looseness of the Rouran themselves: the khagan Datān and the chiefs of the several clans each held their own power, the league shared only the title of a single khagan and had no unified command in war, and once it was checked the clans fell away separately. The Han adviser Cui Hao entered this campaign in the register of Wei's martial achievements: with the northern victory won, the stele recording it must be raised, as the warrant for a Wei that had established its merit beyond the orthodox dynasties.
impact: 柔然此後再沒有恢復漠北霸權。大檀死後，汗庭的部眾大批西遷或北走，柔然的重心退到蒙古西部與西域東緣；北魏則趁勢在陰山南北修築城塞、設置戍所，把柔然南下的通道一段段封死，此後二十餘年邊境仍有小股抄掠，但大規模入塞基本停止。對西域而言，這一役打開了北魏通往中亞的門戶：北魏在四四〇年代之後接連派使西行，書中記有董溫三使西域一事，相繼有十六國與大月氏來朝，絲路北道在拓跋王朝手上重新熱鬧起來，而這條線再往西，就通向大秦與拂菻的商人與傳教士。北魏在編制上的變化同樣明顯：柔然與高車的降眾被大量編入魏軍，騎兵比例與邊軍實力都因此上升，拓跋部自身的草原血統則被漢門的制度與禮儀重新包裹。史書還記了一件小事，太武帝自以柔然人智力低下有如蠕蟲，下令改稱柔然為蠕蟲，這個帶著輕蔑的譚號說明征服者雖在疆場上得手，對遊牧者仍缺乏真正理解。代價與限度也擺在史書裏：這場戰爭並沒有消滅柔然這個部族，敕連可汗仍在漠北重整旗鼓，直到太武帝再征將其殺死，柔然才真正崩解；五五五年取代它的突厥崛起，同一塊草原上換了主人。對後世另一條線索而言，有學者依據歐亞大陸的考古與族源研究指出，柔然與六世紀進入東歐建立阿瓦爾汗國的阿瓦爾人可能存在淵源關係，於是這場發生在蒙古高原的戰役，與卡面那把早已退出軍隊的羅馬短劍，在歐亞大陸的兩端各自延續了很長一段時間。
impactEn: The Rouran never recovered their hegemony over the northern steppe. After the death of Datān large numbers of the court's clans moved west or north, and the centre of gravity of the Rouran shifted to the western steppe and the eastern fringe of the western regions. The Wei took the opportunity to build forts and set up garrisons on both sides of the Yin mountains, sealing the approaches by which the Rouran came south section by section; small raids continued along the frontier for more than twenty years afterwards, but large-scale incursions largely stopped. For the western regions this campaign opened the door that led from the Wei to Central Asia: in the 440s the Wei sent envoys west repeatedly, the histories recording the three missions of Dong Wen to the western regions, and the sixteen states and the Great Yuezhi came in turn to court, so that the northern road of the Silk Road grew busy again under the Tuoba dynasty, and further west that road ran to the merchants and missionaries of Daqin and Fulin. The change in the Wei's military organisation was equally visible: Rouran and Gaoche defectors were incorporated into the Wei army in large numbers, the proportion of cavalry and the effective strength of the frontier troops both rose, and the steppe blood of the Tuoba clan itself was re-wrapped in the institutions and ritual of the Han. The histories preserve a small detail too: Taiwu judged the Rouran people to be of dull intelligence like worms and ordered that the Rouran be renamed worms, and that insulting epithet shows that the conquerors, for all they won on the field, had not truly understood the nomads. The cost and the limit are also in the histories: this war did not destroy the Rouran as a people. Chilian rebuilt himself in the northern steppe, and only a second expedition by Taiwu, which killed him, truly broke the state; in 555 the Turks rose in its place, and the same grassland changed hands. For another line running into later history, scholars have argued on the basis of archaeology and ethnic evidence across Eurasia that the Rouran may stand in some relation to the Avars who entered eastern Europe and founded the Avar khaganate in the sixth century; and so this battle fought on the Mongolian plateau and the Roman short sword on the card, long out of military service, each ran on for a very long time at the two ends of the Eurasian landmass.
result: 公元四二九年這場戰役的結局是清楚的：北魏大軍深入瀚海與弱水一線，重創柔然，斬首三萬餘級、俘虜二萬餘口、掠走馬牛羊以百萬計，可汗大檀同年而死，汗庭西遷，敕連可汗在殘部簇擁下接位，柔然失去對漠南的壟斷。對北魏而言，目標並非滅國而是破局：此後陰山一線的城塞與戍所成為長期邊防的骨架，柔然犯塞的規模大幅下降，北魏得以把注意力轉向河西與中原，四三一年涼州歸魏，四三六年北燕覆亡，四三九年統一北方，五三四年北魏分裂為東魏、西魏，五五八年北周代魏，直到隋文帝於五八九年滅陳，全域的統一才真正完成。對柔然而言，這是一場決定性的失敗而不是終局：可汗死了，部眾散了，但這個部族仍在漠北重建了勢力，並在十五年後再遭致命打擊，直到五五五年才被突厥所吞。戰役本身留下來的，不只是兩軍的斬獲，還有一塊立在鄴的崑崙山碑，碑文由相國崔浩撰寫，記錄北伐的經過與武功，也記錄了太武帝希望後世如何看見這場戰爭；碑在十年後被毀，文字卻仍藉史書留下片段。
resultEn: The outcome of the campaign of 429 CE is clear: the Wei army drove deep between the Hanjai and the Rouran River, struck the Rouran hard, cut down more than thirty thousand, took more than twenty thousand prisoners and carried off horses, cattle and sheep by the hundred thousand; the khagan Datān died within the year, the court moved west, and Chilian was raised by the remnants, while the Rouran lost their grip on the southern steppe. For the Wei the aim was never the destruction of the state but the breaking of the situation: the forts and garrisons along the Yin mountains became the frame of a lasting frontier defence, the scale of the Rouran raids fell sharply, and the Wei was free to turn its attention to Hexi and the central plains, with Hexi coming to the Wei in 431, the Northern Yan destroyed in 436, the north united in 439, the empire splitting into Eastern and Western Wei in 534, Northern Zhou replacing Wei in 558, and true unity of the whole country not arriving until Sui Wendi destroyed Chen in 589. For the Rouran this was a decisive defeat and not an ending: the khagan was dead and the clans scattered, yet the people rebuilt themselves in the northern steppe and took a second mortal blow fifteen years later, and were swallowed by the Turks only in 555. What the campaign left behind was not merely the two sides' tally of killed and captured, but a stele set up at Ye, the Kunlun Mountain stele, whose text was composed by the chancellor Cui Hao; it recorded the course of the northern expedition and the martial merit, and it recorded too how Taiwu wished later ages to see this war. The stele was destroyed ten years afterwards, yet its words survive in fragments in the histories.
